title: DC-area forecast: Staying steamy as more storms sweep by
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Scattered showers and storms sweep through mostly the northern half of the area between late morning and early afternoon. Then rather muggy with highs in the upper 80s to mid-90s.

What’s next? Still hot and humid Friday, with more 90s likely and another chance of storms. Then trending cooler with less humidity for the holiday weekend.

Today’s daily digit — 3/10: A three for Sept. 3, but mostly because of the high heat and humidity. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Thursday): A front that sagged south of the area yesterday lifts back north today. That means it'll be hotter again, with afternoon highs in a range of 89 to 95, from coolest spots north to toastier locations south of DC. With humid dew points of 70 to 75, heat index values reaching the upper 90s to low 100s are likely, especially in southern parts of the area where there's a heat advisory.

Scattered showers and storms are a good between between late morning and early afternoon, especially in the northern half of the area. They may weaken or dissipate before reaching areas farther south. Partial clearing should follow the storms. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: Scattered showers and storms are a possibility, especially after 9 or 10 p.m. and into the overnight. Spots that see a heavier storm could pick up a quick half-inch of rain or more. Under mostly cloudy skies, temperatures only fall off to the 70s. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Friday): The front makes its way back south. It'll take some time to scour out the air mass, so humidity remains high with dew points still near 70, and there's a chance for scattered afternoon thunderstorms. Highs mainly reach the upper 80s to low 90s. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: Clearing the humidity out of here could still be slow, so it may stay muggy much of the night. By dawn, drier air should be more noticeable as skies clear. Lows in the upper 60s to mid-70s. Confidence: Medium-High

A look ahead

Partly sunny Saturday with decreasing humidity, but a few showers are still possible, especially west and south of DC. Highss reach the low to mid-80s. Confidence: Medium

Looking really nice Sunday into Labor Day Monday. Both days feature highs ranging from the upper 70s to low 80s most spots. Mainly sunny on Sunday, with a few more clouds for Monday. Confidence: Medium

DC weather history for September 3

A powerful 1821 hurricane brought widespread coastal devastation, while in 1909 an early-season chill set record lows during a prolonged stretch of cool weather.
